- Logs & retention: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)

Avery / Soojin — quick prep notes before the 9:30 call.

I mapped the SIG rows to our internal artifacts and flagged potential gaps:
- "Logging: retention" (SIG row 14) — we currently have 180-day retention for request logs, 365 for system logs; Oxbridge asked about multi-region archive. I can export retention policy and S3 lifecycle rules.
- "Encryption in transit & at rest" (rows 3–4) — Soojin, can you pull current KMS key policy and diagram for CMKs + rotation cadence?
- "Admin access reviews" (row 27) — we have quarterly reviews; I can pull the last two review artifacts and the JIRA tickets that tracked remediation.
- "Incident RCA samples" — I have redacted RCAs for two incidents in the last 12 months; need confirmation on redaction scope before sharing.

Action items for call:
- Marissa: prepare export links for logs retention policy + sample logs (anonymized)
- Soojin: KMS key policy, HSM/KMS integration note, key rotation schedule (pdf)
- Avery: prepare short script to explain scope boundaries (what we host vs. what Oxbridge manages)

Timeboxed: I'll have all links in the shared Drive folder before the call. If anything unexpected pops up, I'll DM.

-Marissa

Redwood Inference
